Extended WhatsApp exchange between rep Sam Karimi and client Layla Haddad covering a property search (Arabian Ranches area, with later requirements around airport proximity, schooling, and a gym), several client and rep promises, and recurring concerns about rent costs, competing agents, and specific properties viewed. Ongoing property search chat between Sam Karimi and client Layla Haddad (with her husband Karim); budget, bedroom count, and investment needs evolved over several weeks, and Sam made several commitments on documentation and viewings. Mostly routine back-and-forth messaging between rep Sam Karimi and client Layla Haddad with several property listings shared; a meeting was set for Thursday 12 November 2026 at 4pm at the office, and Layla mentioned her and Karim's key personal dates and a tentative decision timeline.
